title: 第469章 水的运动第468章 出口
slug: 我的灵根等级怎么是负的
content_zh:
几分钟后，一行人来到一处类似竞技场的地方。与之前的竞技场相比，这个竞技场规模小得多，也远没有那么气派。之前的竞技场直径约50公里，而这个竞技场只有30公里宽。
此外，地面并非由某种强大的矿石构成。据格拉维斯观察，竞技场内的地面只是普通的泥土。或许每次使用后，都会有掘地者对竞技场进行修缮。唯一非泥土构成的是环绕竞技场的城墙，它们是由某种王级矿石打造而成。
然而，即便格拉维斯明白这一切，他却毫不在意。此刻，他完全沉浸在自己的情绪之中。这条愚蠢的规则让他无比沮丧和愤怒，他现在只想好好发泄一番。鳄鱼真是倒霉，偏偏在这个敏感时期挑衅他。
把所有的情绪都发泄在一个素未谋面的野兽身上，这公平吗？
这取决于。
如果格拉维斯只是这样攻击别人，有人可能会说格拉维斯没有权利攻击对方。然而，通过发出挑战，决定权就落到了鳄鱼身上。如果格拉维斯拒绝，它就无法对鳄鱼采取任何行动，否则就会被某个长老杀死。
鳄鱼接受了决斗，这巧妙地将格拉维斯的怒火发泄转化成了一场生死较量。至于这场生死较量的原因并不重要。野兽之间为了变得更强大，互相争斗、互相残杀是常有的事。
格拉维斯重重地撞在竞技场中央，震碎了大片泥土。他怒目圆睁地望着空荡荡的前方。等鳄鱼一进场，他就能好好发泄一番心中的怒火了。
“进去吧，”猴子对鳄鱼说。“一旦你进入竞技场，不杀了他就出不来。”
鳄鱼只是冷笑一声。“我很期待这场战斗。我知道所有饲养员都能与比自己高两级的野兽战斗。我并不狂妄到认为这场战斗会轻而易举，但如果真是这样就更好了。我一生中经历过无数艰难的战斗，我很享受挑战。”
格拉维斯等鳄鱼的时候越来越不耐烦了。这整个过程也太慢了！
鳄鱼微微低头看向猴子后，悠闲地飞入竞技场。几秒钟后，它到达竞技场中央，格拉维斯面前，然后轻轻地落在地上。
“今天将——”
格拉维斯的双脚迸发出闪电，速度快得惊人。他已经很久没用过这种技巧了，因为他的闪电变身本身速度就更快。
鳄鱼完全没有做好准备，正当它想要躲闪时，一股强大的压力突然出现并压在它身上，使其速度减慢了大约20%。由于这次误判，它错过了最佳时机。
格拉维斯一拳打在鳄鱼的鼻子上，闪电猛烈地从他的嘴里迸发而出。鳄鱼的鼻子断了，被击飞到几公里外。
格拉维斯晋升为三级领主时，他的闪电威力已达到初始威力的393%。相对于三级领主的整体实力而言，他的闪电威力仅比四级领主弱7%。
在此期间，格拉维斯疯狂地转移着他的力量中心。他削弱了自己的肉体，增强了闪电的力量，以求达到最快的速度。然后，他将所有力量注入精神之中，使他的意志光环达到极致。最后，他又将力量重新分配到肉体和闪电之中，以增强攻击力。
所以，即便格拉维斯只是三级领主，这一击的威力也足以伤到五级领主。攻击过后，格拉维斯只是看着鳄鱼被他一拳打飞，远远地望着它。
与此同时，旁观的猴子瞪大了眼睛，惊愕不已。这速度对于一个三级领主来说也太惊人了！而且，鳄鱼的鼻子也被这一击打得多处骨折。

在骄傲山附近，白猿也点头赞许。一周前的战斗中，格拉维斯未能展现全部实力，因此他的确切战斗力对白猿和女皇来说仍然是个谜。白猿期待着见识格拉维斯更强大的力量。
格拉维斯没有发动第二次攻击，而是静静地等待鳄鱼出现。
几秒钟后，鳄鱼从最初的惊吓中缓过神来，恢复了镇定。随后，它勃然大怒。它迅速站起身，怒火中烧地瞪着格拉维斯。
格拉维斯从远处回头望去。“通常情况下，我早就用更强大的攻击杀了你，”格拉维斯冷冷地说，“但今天，你不是我的克星。你只是我发泄怒火的工具。我不想一击毙命。过来！”格拉维斯喊道。
格拉维斯说的都是实话。如果他想的话，他完全可以把一枚预先装好子弹的闪电新月弹射到鳄鱼脸上。如果他那样做了，鳄鱼早就死了。
低估敌人是战斗中最大的错误。许多人和野兽都因此丧命于格拉维斯之手，如果格拉维斯愿意，那条鳄鱼早就成了他们中的一员了。
鳄鱼听到这话，更加愤怒了。这个区区三级领主不仅毁了它的鼻子，还敢瞧不起它！然而，鳄鱼意识到格拉维斯实力强大。现在，它要用尽一切力量杀死他！
鳄鱼飞上了天空，但不知为何，它的飞行方式与其他野兽截然不同。其他野兽总是悬停在空中，仿佛下方有一个看不见的移动平台。
与此同时，鳄鱼的身体微微上下起伏，它的脚和尾巴搅动着周围的空气。从各方面来看，这只鳄鱼看起来就像是浸在水里，而不是在空气中。
鳄鱼脚和尾巴周围的扭曲让格拉维斯想起了细小的水流。仿佛空气在鳄鱼周围流动，如同水一般。格拉维斯确信，这就是鳄鱼领悟的那条法则在起作用。他记得猴子说过，鳄鱼懂得一条法则。
鳄鱼以惊人的速度向前冲去，速度甚至超过了普通的五级神兽。多亏了格拉维斯的灵力感知，他才能在鳄鱼冲锋的同时，注意到它身上所有的细微差别。
它周围的空气只有在它的脚、胳膊和尾巴后面才像水一样流动。它的四肢和身体前部却丝毫没有这种流动的迹象。格拉维斯立刻明白了鳄鱼为什么能跑得这么快。
水的密度比空气大得多，因此阻力也大得多。如果一个凡人在空中挥舞手臂和腿，也只能朝着目标方向移动非常缓慢。仅靠空气阻力很难推动自己前进。
水与陆地不同，凡人可以在水中轻松游泳并前进。虽然人类在水中的速度可能不如在陆地上快，但肯定比在空气中“游泳”要快得多。
通过使鳄鱼身后的空气像水一样运动，它可以利用更大的阻力向前推进。此外，由于其身体前部仍然像普通空气一样运动，鳄鱼既获得了水流运动的优势，又忽略了其劣势。这使得它能够如此快速地游动。
格拉维斯确信这条法则与水的运动有关。法则能够改变使用者周围的世界。他或许从未见过如此运用法则的例子，但这合情合理。
幸好鳄鱼离得比较远，这给了格拉维斯足够的反应时间。如果鳄鱼更近，他可能就来不及应对如此惊人的速度了。
鳄鱼迅速追上了格拉维斯。
content_en:
A few minutes later, the group came to a place that looked like an arena. This arena is much smaller and far less imposing than the previous one. The previous arena was about 50 kilometers in diameter, while this one is only 30 kilometers wide.
Furthermore, the ground is not made of some powerful ore. According to Gravis' observation, the ground in the arena was just ordinary dirt. Maybe there will be diggers repairing the arena after every use. The only things that weren't made of earth were the walls surrounding the arena, which were made of some kind of king-level ore.
However, even though Gravis understood all this, he didn't care. At this moment, he was completely immersed in his emotions. This stupid rule made him extremely frustrated and angry, and now he just wanted to vent it out. The crocodile was really unlucky to provoke him at this sensitive period.
Is it fair to vent all your emotions on a beast you've never met?
it depends.
If Gravis only attacks others like this, one might say that Graves has no right to attack others. However, by issuing the challenge, the decision fell to the crocodile. If Graves refuses, it cannot take any action against the crocodile or it will be killed by one of the elders.
Crocodile accepts the duel, which subtly turns Gravis's outburst of rage into a life-or-death contest. The reason for this life and death battle is not important. In order to become stronger, it is common for beasts to fight and kill each other.
Gravis hit the center of the arena hard, shattering large swaths of dirt. He stared angrily at the empty space ahead. Once the crocodile enters the scene, he can vent his anger.
"Go in," said the monkey to the crocodile. "Once you enter the arena, you can't get out without killing him."
The crocodile just sneered. "I'm looking forward to this fight. I know all breeders can fight against beasts two levels above themselves. I'm not so arrogant as to think this fight will be easy, but it would be nice if it were. I've been through a lot of tough fights in my life and I enjoy the challenge."
Graves grew impatient as he waited for the crocodile. This whole process is too slow!
The crocodile lowered his head slightly to look at the monkey, then flew leisurely into the arena. After a few seconds, it reached the center of the arena, in front of Gravis, and landed softly on the ground.
"Today will-"
Graves' feet erupted with lightning at an astonishing speed. He hasn't used this technique in a long time since his lightning transformation is inherently faster.
The crocodile was completely unprepared. Just as it was about to dodge, a strong pressure suddenly appeared and pressed on it, slowing it down by about 20%. Because of this misjudgment, it missed the best opportunity.
Graves punched the crocodile on the nose, and lightning violently burst out of his mouth. The crocodile's nose was broken and it was knocked several kilometers away.
When Gravis was promoted to the third level Lord, his lightning power had reached 393% of its initial power. Relative to the overall strength of the third-level lord, his lightning power is only 7% weaker than that of the fourth-level lord.
During this time, Graves frantically shifted his center of power. He weakened his body and increased the power of his lightning in order to achieve maximum speed. Then, he poured all his power into his spirit, reaching the aura of his will to the extreme. Finally, he redistributed his power into his body and lightning to increase his attack power.
Therefore, even if Gravis is only a third-level lord, the power of this blow is enough to hurt a fifth-level lord. After the attack, Gravis just watched the crocodile fly away with his punch, watching it from a distance.
At the same time, the monkeys who were watching were wide-eyed and shocked. This speed is too amazing for a third-level lord! Moreover, the crocodile’s noseThe child also suffered multiple fractures from the blow.
Near Pride Mountain, the white ape also nodded in approval. In the battle a week ago, Gravis failed to show his full strength, so his exact fighting prowess remains a mystery to the White Ape and the Queen. The White Ape is looking forward to seeing Gravis' greater power.
Gravis did not launch a second attack, but quietly waited for the crocodile to appear.
After a few seconds, the crocodile recovered from its initial fright and regained its composure. Then it flew into a rage. It stood up quickly and glared at Gravis angrily.
Gravis looked back from a distance. "Normally, I would have killed you with a more powerful attack," Gravis said coldly, "But today, you are not my nemesis. You are just a tool for me to vent my anger. I don't want to kill you with one blow. Come here!" Graves shouted.
Graves told the truth. If he had wanted to, he could have fired a pre-loaded Lightning Crescent projectile into the alligator's face. If he had done that, the crocodile would have died.
Underestimating your enemy is the biggest mistake in combat. Many men and beasts had perished at Graves's hands, and if Graves had wished, the crocodile would have become one of them.
When the crocodile heard this, he became even more angry. This mere third-level lord not only ruined its nose, but also dared to look down on it! However, Crocodile realizes that Gravis is powerful. Now, it wants to use all its strength to kill him!
The crocodile takes to the sky, but for some reason, the way it flies is completely different from other beasts. Other beasts always hover in the air, as if there is an invisible moving platform below.
At the same time, the crocodile's body rose and fell slightly, its feet and tail stirring the surrounding air. To all appearances, the crocodile looks like it's submerged in water rather than air.
The twists around the crocodile's feet and tail reminded Graves of tiny streams of water. It was as if air was flowing around the crocodile, like water. Gravis was convinced that this was the law at work that the crocodile understood. He remembered the monkey saying that the crocodile knew a law.
The crocodile rushed forward at an astonishing speed, even faster than an ordinary level five beast. Thanks to Graves' psychic perception, he was able to notice all the nuances of the crocodile as it charged.
The air around it flows like water only behind its feet, arms and tail. Its limbs and front of its body showed no sign of this flow. Graves immediately understood why the crocodile could run so fast.
Water is much denser than air, so the resistance is much greater. If a mortal waved his arms and legs in the air, he could only move very slowly in the direction of his target. It's difficult to propel yourself forward using air resistance alone.
Water is different from land in that mortals can easily swim and move forward in water. Although humans may not be as fast in the water as on land, they are certainly much faster than "swimming" in the air.
By causing the air behind the crocodile to move like water, it can use more resistance to propel itself forward. Furthermore, because the front of its body still moves like ordinary air, the crocodile both gains the advantages of water motion and ignores its disadvantages. This allows it to swim so quickly.
Graves was convinced that this law had to do with the movement of water. Laws can change the world around the user. He may have never seen an example of the law being used in this way, but it made sense.
Fortunately, the crocodile was far away, which gave Gravis enough time to react. If the crocodile had been closer, he might not have had enough time to deal with the incredible speed.
The crocodile quickly caught up with Gravis.
